div.head: II As 17
div.ab: Be ðæm ðe æt þeofe medsceatte nimaþ. Gif hwa æt ðeofe medsceat nime ⁊ oþres rihte afylle, be he his weres scyldig.
Syxte: Gif hwa æt þeofe medsceat nime ⁊ oþres ryht afylle, beo (he) his weres scyldig.
Syxte: Gif hwa æt ðeofe metsce …, beo his weres scyldig.
De illis qui a fure munera suscipiunt. Si quis a fure munera suscipiat (uel mercedem accipiat) et rectum alicuius peruertat (aut adnichilet), werę suę reus sit.
[Be þæm ðe æt þeofe medsceatte nimaþ.] [Ld] Syxte: Gif hwa æt þeofe medsceat nime ⁊ oþres ryht afylle, beo he his weres scyldig.
Sixthly: [we declare] if anyone takes bribes from a thief and [by so doing] frustrates the just claims of another, he shall forfeit his wergeld.

(Über die, welche Bestechung von einem Verbrecher annehmen. Ld) Sechstens: wenn jemand von einem Verbrecher Bestechung annimmt und er [deshalb] den Rechtsanspruch eines dritten zu Falle bringt, sei er sein Wergeld [dem König] schuldig.
(Of those who take a bribe from a criminal. Ld) Sixthly: if anyone takes a bribe from a criminal and [therefore] defeats a third party's legal claim, let him be liable for his wergild [to the king].
